verdict.rationale: Column exposes rail-specific metadata, notably full raw Fedwire messages via the get-wire-transfer endpoint. It also offers a unified transfers query endpoint across payment types and transaction-level reports in CSV, JSON and Parquet, which together give developers a reasonably detailed raw feed. Missing for 10: documented counterparty detail fields, explicit stable transaction identifiers, any enrichment layer (categorization, merchant/counterparty normalization), and independent hands-on corroboration of data richness.
